fields.label: Action Index
fields.description: 0-based position within the rule's ordered actions list (multi-action rules log one row per action).

fields.label: Execution Metadata
fields.description: Traceability + retry/concurrency observability for safe automation on real customer data.

fields.label: Execution ID
fields.description: Globally unique ID for one rule execution — groups all action rows from a single trigger fire. Generated by the engine at dispatch time.

fields.label: Correlation ID
fields.description: Links this automation run back to the originating event — the same ID threaded through BP Activity and BP Audit Log for end-to-end tracing.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: What initiated this execution: a Frappe event, a scheduled job, the gateway engine, an external webhook, or a manual run.

fields.label: Attempt
fields.description: 1-based retry count — 1 = first try, 2 = first retry, etc. Matches the conflict-retry loop in apply_action.

fields.label: Started At
fields.description: When the engine began executing this action (precise to the second).

fields.label: Finished At
fields.description: When the engine finished (success, skip, or failure) this action.

fields.label: Duration (ms)
fields.description: finished_at - started_at in milliseconds. Derived on write.

fields.label: Error Code
fields.description: Short machine-readable error class (e.g. TimestampMismatchError, LinkValidationError, PermissionError) — extracted from the exception type, not the message.

fields.label: Retry At
fields.description: When a retry is scheduled (if applicable). Null for non-retryable failures or successes.
